title: Fleet/bro dispatches can't carry operator MCP servers — fleet.json mcpServers translation is dead code
wanted_capability: Dispatched fleet/bro agents (harness providers) should be able to discover and call operator-configured MCP servers (e.g. the tmux MCP) — rendered conventions instruct agents to prefer tmux MCP for TUI validation, but dispatches receive exactly one MCP server (the transient blackbox daemon via BLACKBOX_MCP_URL), so agents silently fall back to raw shell tmux. The injection seam exists end-to-end but is unwired: fleet.json's mcpServers map is parsed by the cockpit config and round-tripped, build_fleet_mcp_args/fleet_mcp_config_json (src/orchestration/providers/mcp_args.rs:164,190) translate a server map into --mcp-config for harness providers, and build_in_process_mcp_config (src/orchestration/mod.rs:3202) consumes --mcp-config at spawn — but no dispatch path ever calls build_fleet_mcp_args (both fns are #[allow(dead_code)] with a §7 note).
missing_primitive: A dispatch-path wire from configured MCP servers (fleet.json mcpServers, or a brofile/per-dispatch server list) through build_fleet_mcp_args into the spawned harness's McpConfig — plus a policy decision on which dispatch origins get which servers (security surface: secrets resolve at injection).
fallback_used: Agents use raw `tmux` shell commands via shell_run instead of the tmux MCP tools.
evidence: crates/bro-fleet-client/src/fleet.rs fleet.json mcpServers 'parsed and round-tripped but not interpreted'
resolution_note: Shipped in f37ce3de (worktree-fleet-mcp-servers-wiring): spawn_task_with_tool_placement now resolves fleet.json mcpServers via fleet_mcp_dispatch_args and appends provider-translated --mcp-config to the dispatch argv; client-local shape converts to daemon SecretString shape by serde round-trip; skip-with-warning on unconvertible/unresolvable servers. Policy (operator-selected): Cockpit-origin only — automation origins (workflow/atom/cron/webhook) inject nothing; the gate short-circuits before any fleet.json read. Wire form is the harness's own --mcp-config CLI flag in the parsed argv, preserving extraction of bro-harness to a standalone subprocess with zero rewiring (harness-daemon-boundary.md §7). /control/resume keeps Cockpit origin so follow-up turns re-inject.
